headline: Tong Hui Kang reaches 20th, just outside ARC-3 gold

sections.text: Tong Hui Kang gained 3.93 points to reach 37.92, climbing from 63rd to 20th on the ARC-AGI-3 public board.
The gold line held at 37.98, leaving the 19th-place cutoff 0.06 ahead of Kang. The public board remains provisional.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
